narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Sixty four is even, so it is divisible by six.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Its digits add to ten, and ten is not a multiple of three.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Passing one test is not enough. Sixty four leaves four over in sixes.

<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Which of forty two, fifty four, seventy and ninety one are divisible by six?
